meta.name: game-start
meta.description: Invoke when the user wants to start a new game project, set up project scaffolding, onboard into an existing codebase, or initialize GameForge session state. Triggers on: "start a game", "new game project", "set up project", "project onboarding", "initialize project". Do NOT invoke for brainstorming ideas (use game-brainstorm) or prototyping mechanics (use game-prototype). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速搭建新游戏项目脚手架
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正要开始一个新游戏项目或加入现有代码库。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly scaffold a new game project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are starting a new game project or joining an existing codebase.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你启动新游戏项目或加入现有项目。它会自动检测项目状态（空文件夹、有设计文档无代码、开发中、成熟项目），然后给出对应的搭建步骤、文件结构建议和文档模板。
howto.when: 当你说“开始一个新游戏”、“设置项目”、“加入现有项目”或“初始化项目”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 我想开始一个新游戏项目，用Godot引擎。
say.note: Claude会检测项目状态并引导搭建文件结构。

say.text: 帮我看看这个现有项目的结构健康吗？
say.note: Claude会扫描代码库并给出改进建议。

say.text: 我有个游戏概念文档，但还没写代码。
say.note: Claude会审查文档并指出缺失的关键部分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you start a new game project or onboard into an existing one. It automatically detects the project state (empty, concept-only, in-progress, mature) and provides tailored scaffolding steps, file structure suggestions, and document templates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "start a new game", "set up project", "join existing project", "initialize project", or similar keywords.

say_en.text: I want to start a new game project using Godot.
say_en.note: Claude detects project state and guides scaffolding.

say_en.text: Check the health of this existing project.
say_en.note: Claude scans codebase and suggests improvements.

say_en.text: I have a game concept doc but no code yet.
say_en.note: Claude reviews docs and identifies missing sections.
